title: Single Cell and Single Nuclei Analysis of Human Heart Tissue
author: Monika Litvinukova
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.veae3ae

steps.title: Clean and Orient Tissue
steps.instruction: Transfer the tissue into a petri dish containing 1ml of dPBS and carefully remove fat without damaging the pericardium layer. Determine tissue orientation based on layer characteristics: ventricular tissue (stiff, light-pink to white pericardium; dark red myocardium and endocardium) or atrial tissue (stiffer, thinner, with external fat).

steps.title: Freeze Tissue Block in OCT
steps.instruction: Prepare a tissue section with maximum dimensions of 7mm x 7mm and a depth of 2-3mm, ensuring a clean cross-section through all layers. Place the section into a mold with the pericardium facing up and lower it into pre-cooled isopentane. Once frozen, cover the tissue in OCT, leave on dry ice until frozen, and store the filled mold at -80°C.

steps.title: Prepare Tissue for Paraffin Embedding
steps.instruction: Prepare a tissue section with maximum dimensions of 7mm x 7mm and a depth of 2-3mm, ensuring a clean cross-section through all layers. Fix the section in a formalin cup for 16-24h, gradually dehydrate in ethanol, and store frozen at -20°C. Embed the tissue into paraffin and store until sectioning.

steps.title: Mince and Aliquot Tissue
steps.instruction: Mince the remaining tissue into small cubes (approximately 2mm) to minimize spatial bias. Separate 200mg for tissue dissociation, split the remaining tissue into approximately 200mg portions in cryotubes, flash-freeze in liquid nitrogen, and store at -80°C.

steps.title: Digest Tissue
steps.instruction: Transfer 200mg of minced tissue into a 1.5ml Eppendorf tube containing digestion buffer using a scalpel, minimizing dPBS transfer. Seal the tube with parafilm and place in a waterbath at 37°C for 15 minutes with agitation, gently shaking by hand every 5 minutes.

steps.title: Triturate and Filter Cells
steps.instruction: Place the digested tube on ice and triturate by pipetting up and down 5-10 times using a 5ml pipette. Filter the solution through a 100µm cell strainer, gently rubbing the tissue through with a 1ml plunger, and wash the strainer with 8.5ml of DMEM to reach a final volume of 10ml cell suspension.

steps.title: Optional Chromium Controller Filtration
steps.instruction: If the sample is intended for a Chromium controller, filter the solution through a 70µm strainer and wash with an additional 5ml of DMEM.

steps.title: Wash and Concentrate Cells
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the suspension at 300 x g for 5 minutes at 4°C. Discard the supernatant and wash the pellet with 10ml of dPBS + 2% FBS.

steps.title: Perform Percoll Gradient Centrifugation
steps.instruction: Create a 27% Percoll-cell solution by adding 2.86ml of Percoll solution to the cells. Transfer to a high-speed Falcon tube, prepare a balance tube, and centrifuge at 15,000 x g for 20 minutes at 4°C (break option set to 4 or slowed down).

steps.title: Recover and Resuspend Cells
steps.instruction: Collect the cell-cloud using a 1ml pipette. Wash the cells in dPBS + 0.04% BSA and resuspend in 100µl of dPBS + 0.04% BSA.

steps.title: Assess Cell Quality
steps.instruction: Count the cells and assess morphology via microscopy. Assess viability using Trypan Blue. Adjust concentration for the 10X protocol.

steps.title: Homogenize Frozen Tissue for Nuclei
steps.instruction: Retrieve a 200mg portion of minced frozen tissue from -80°C storage and keep on dry ice. Transfer pieces into a precooled 7ml Dounce homogenizer and add 3ml of HB. Homogenize with 8 strokes of the loose pestle and 8 strokes of the tight pestle, keeping on ice. Add more strokes if homogenization is incomplete.

steps.title: Filter and Pellet Nuclei
steps.instruction: Filter the homogenized tissue through a 40µm cell strainer into a 50ml tube. Wash the homogenizer with 2x 1ml of the remaining HB. Centrifuge at 500 x g for 5 minutes at 4°C and remove the supernatant entirely.

steps.title: Stain Nuclei
steps.instruction: Resuspend the nuclei pellet in 1ml of SB. Add 2 drops of NucBlue and incubate for 10 minutes.

steps.title: FACS Sort Nuclei
steps.instruction: Sort nuclei into an Eppendorf tube containing 200µl of SB. Set gates to select DAPI-stained nuclei; exclude particles smaller than 1µm, doublets, and irregularly shaped debris.

steps.title: Final Nuclei Recovery and Counting
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the sorted nuclei at 500 x g for 5 minutes at 4°C. Remove the supernatant entirely and resuspend the pellet in 100µl of SB. Count the nuclei 4 times using a Countess and Trypan Blue, then adjust concentration for loading onto the 10X chip.
